summary: DROPFIX iteration 3 regression + new-features test. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass including the 3 new tests for POST /api/upload (PNG accepted, size/content_type/is_video/path/url returned correctly), text/plain rejected with 400, GET /api/files/{path} round-trip returns the exact bytes with image/png content-type, and POST /api/reports now accepts and persists photo_urls + video_urls. All prior regressions (health, list/filters/search, GET single, tracking valid/invalid/unknown, PATCH status + timeline, PATCH moderate, POST officer-ai-summary, voice/structure real-Gemini Tamil, advisories, clusters, analytics, audit-logs, demo-users) still pass. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): new redesigned Home renders with Report Issue hero + 100% Anonymous badge + Photo Evidence/Ward GPS/AI Priority chips + 4 stat counters (11 Active / 5 Investigating / 1 Resolved / 5 Alerts) + Quick Services & Tools grid (Track Report, Public Map, AI Assistant, Voice Assistant, Smart Navigator, Water Safety) + Alerts Near You section. New bottom tab bar renders all 5 testIDs (tab-btn-home, tab-btn-map, tab-btn-voice-mic centre, tab-btn-ai, tab-btn-settings). home-area-picker-btn opens area-picker-sheet; selecting Karnataka updates advisories. AI Assistant screen shows ai-open-voice-btn (opens voice modal) and ai-open-guide-btn. Settings screen shows all language pills (en/ta/te/kn/ml) + role pills (citizen/officer/admin) + settings-open-dashboard-btn; Tamil switch translates UI; Officer & Admin dashboards render (though top-level container testIDs are absent). Voice modal opens from centre mic and from AI Assistant. Report end-to-end works: hero card -> report-description-input + report-locality-input -> submit-report-form-btn -> submission-success-modal shows DF-2026-TN-7049 / TRK-08811. Evidence buttons evidence-pick-library-btn and evidence-capture-camera-btn render (native picker cannot be automated in web preview). Track flow: tool-track -> sample-track-tn-btn -> tracked-incident-details for DF-2026-TN-4821 renders. Public Map shows state filter + Map/List(10) toggle + regional grid + pin list. Deprecated packages detected: NONE (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch in package.json). React Native web deprecation warnings persist (shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver) but non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: No top-level testID (officer-dashboard-screen/admin-dashboard-screen) — dashboards render fine visually via settings-open-dashboard-btn, but test hooks can't assert screen mount cleanly.
Map view toggle buttons lack dedicated testIDs (e.g. map-toggle-map-btn / map-toggle-list-btn). Toggle is visible ('Map' and 'List (10)' pills) but selectors are text-based.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported...' on web preview. Gate with Platform.OS or set useNativeDriver:false on web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Splash3DAnimation.tsx
React Native web deprecation warnings: shadow* → boxShadow and props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add top-level testID to Officer/Admin dashboards (officer-dashboard-screen, admin-dashboard-screen) and to the Public Map map/list toggle buttons for cleaner E2E hooks.
OPTIONAL: Silence React Native web deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents, Platform.OS gate for useNativeDriver on web).
OPTIONAL: /api/seed is still publicly callable and wipes all data — consider guarding by an admin token before production.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx is still a very large single file (>2400 LoC). Recommend splitting into feature screens (Home, Report, Track, Map, AI, Settings, Operations) and hooks per code-review guidelines (>700 LoC threshold).
PATCH /reports/{id}/status, /moderate, POST /advisories and POST /seed remain unauthenticated (acceptable for demo, must be hardened for production).
seed_data_creation: Created ~4 TEST_-prefixed reports via pytest + UI (Kerala TEST_Ward, Karnataka TEST_MediaWard, Tamil Nadu TEST_UI_Ward, plus repeat TEST_Ward) and 1 TEST_ advisory. Also 1 tiny PNG uploaded to Emergent Object Storage under dropfix/uploads/citizen/*.png (kept minimal per handoff note).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testIDs verified this iteration: Home hero = home-report-hero (NOT home-hero-report-btn). Report form fields: report-description-input (NOT report-desc-input), report-locality-input, submit-report-form-btn (NOT report-submit-btn). Tools grid: tool-track / tool-map / tool-ai-assistant / tool-voice-assistant / tool-smart-navigator / tool-water-safety. Submission modal close = submission-success-modal contains success-close-btn and success-track-now-btn. Track sample buttons = sample-track-tn-btn / -ka-btn / -kl-btn / -tg-btn. Officer/Admin dashboards have no top-level testID yet — assert via inner content. Splash still gated by splash-enter-app-btn. Offline queue could not be simulated in web preview per handoff note; the code path exists but was not exercised.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. All 4 new features validated end-to-end: (1) Photo/video evidence upload — /api/upload accepts PNG (200 with success/path/url/content_type/is_video/size) and rejects text/plain with 400; /api/files/{path} round-trips bytes with correct image/png. (2) Live Map/dashboard polling — Home shows 'Live · updates automatically' indicator and stat counters render. (3) Offline draft queue — code path present (uploadMedia/IncidentContext) but true airplane-mode simulation not possible in web preview (per handoff note). (4) Nearby Alerts filtered by user's chosen area — home-area-picker-btn → area-picker-sheet → Karnataka updates the Alerts Near You list. Home redesign to white+blue theme + new bottom tab bar (Home | Map | centre voice mic | AI | Settings) matches spec — Report tab intentionally removed; Report is reached via home-report-hero. End-to-end citizen submission produced DF-2026-TN-7049 / TRK-08811.
